$comment: Hand decisions for the ownership registry (apps/api/scripts/db-ownership.mjs). Each entry overrides the heuristic class (A-E) and/or domain and MUST say why. Remove an entry when its table is dropped (the gate fails on a stale one).

process_heartbeats.reason: BUILD_PLAN Phase 14 B (Constitution 11 §154, §49): one row per API / worker process boot (build labels, memory / CPU, the registry digest the System Operations dashboards read) — platform telemetry like system_health_snapshots

device_biometric_credentials.reason: BUILD_PLAN Phase 13 D (Constitution 6 §37-39): a person's Face ID device credential (hashed secret bound to a device id), owned by the user like sessions / refresh_tokens / auth_devices; tenant_id only records the salon of the enrolling session (NULL for a cross-salon customer identity); redeemed by credential id before any tenant context exists

realtime_stream_tickets.reason: BUILD_PLAN Phase 13 (Constitution 6 §28-32): single-use 60 s tickets bound to a person's SESSION (like sessions / refresh_tokens) that open a realtime stream from a native app; redeemed by hash before any tenant context exists

api_operations.reason: BUILD_PLAN Phase 12: the async operation records (exports today) - the job-queue side of the API, beside jobs; tenant_id NULL = a platform (Super Admin) operation

community_appeals.reason: the owners' safety community (Constitution 1 §3 E example 'approved safety-community posts'): one post is read by every salon; visibility is decided by moderation status, not by tenant_id

community_risk_fingerprints.reason: platform moderation signal (hashed fingerprints) used by Super Admin only; never shown to a salon

gift_card_settlement_batches.reason: cross-salon gift card clearing: a batch nets redemptions between issuing and redeeming tenants (program-level, see gift_card_clearing_entries)

nail_showcase_comments.reason: public nail showcase: a comment/reaction on a published post is visible across salons; the post's own visibility rules apply

nail_showcase_photos.reason: public nail showcase: published rows are cross-salon by design; tenant_id (nullable) records the originating salon, not the audience

nail_showcase_posts.reason: public nail showcase: published rows are cross-salon by design; tenant_id (nullable) records the originating salon, not the audience

nail_showcase_reactions.reason: public nail showcase: a comment/reaction on a published post is visible across salons; the post's own visibility rules apply

reviews.reason: a salon's review of its own visit: tenant-owned; global_tech_profile_id only attributes it to the technician's platform profile

tenants.reason: the tenant registry itself: platform-global, keyed by id (no tenant_id by definition)

mobile_app_versions.reason: BUILD_PLAN Phase 13 B (Constitution 6 §55-57): the store apps' version policy (minimum / recommended / latest per app and native platform) - the same binaries serve every salon, so it is platform-global and Super Admin-owned

mobile_app_installs_seen.reason: BUILD_PLAN Phase 13 B (Constitution 6 §150): hashed install id -> app version for the version distribution; no tenant, no user, no raw device id

telemetry_log_events.reason: BUILD_PLAN Phase 14 A (Constitution 11 §291-292): the platform's own redacted log store - lines from every salon's requests and from platform work, read only by Super Admin request search (super_admin.telemetry.*); tenant_id is a NULLable label for filtering, never a scope; written only by the telemetry sink through the worker pool; 14-day retention

telemetry_spans.reason: BUILD_PLAN Phase 14 A: the trace half of the same store (spans of sampled traces), same readers, same writer, same window

oncall_contacts.reason: BUILD_PLAN Phase 14 C (Constitution 11 §262-264): the platform on-call chain (who is paged, in what order, quiet hours) - platform configuration, edited only by Super Admin with step-up

alert_escalations.reason: BUILD_PLAN Phase 14 C (§264-265): each step of a PLATFORM alert's escalation and its acknowledgement (screen or signed single-use link); platform alerts only (tenant_id IS NULL)

slo_validations.reason: BUILD_PLAN Phase 14 C (§80): the platform SLO verdicts computed from platform_request_metrics_minute - one row per SLO, no tenant data

synthetic_monitoring_settings.reason: BUILD_PLAN Phase 14 C (§92-95): single-row platform setting; test_tenant_id NAMES the one salon Kevin designates for the kiosk probe - a reference, not a scope (the row belongs to the platform)

synthetic_probe_results.reason: BUILD_PLAN Phase 14 C: latest result per synthetic probe (rows = probes); platform health, no tenant data

observability_signal_state.reason: BUILD_PLAN Phase 14 C (D8): last-seen platform signal values (break-glass mode) so a toggle opens one security incident fleet-wide

code_lookup_attempts.reason: BUILD_PLAN Phase 14 D (Constitution 12): the lookup-by-code limiter's attempt ledger (gift-card / coupon / deal code guesses) - one weighted row per attempt, keyed by hashed caller / IP and the salon, read only by the limiter; minutes-long window, swept by the central retention executor

turn_unit_rules.reason: Fair Turn Engine (wave 2, migration 601): versioned turn-unit weights per service / category / duration — read and written only by the workforce turn-queue module (turn-queue.service saveRule / retireRule, turn-ledger loadTurnRules)

health_check_runs.reason: Setup Health (Four-Module guide, migration 729): one row per platform setup-health run, written by the Super Admin health service

health_check_results.reason: Setup Health (migration 729): the per-check results of a health run

health_check_alerts.reason: Setup Health (migration 729): open / resolved alerts raised from health results, handled in Super Admin

release_evidence.reason: Setup Health (migration 729): recorded release evidence (gate runs, checks) shown to Super Admin before a deploy

performance_score_snapshots.reason: Team Management round 2 (migration 719): stored staff performance score snapshots, owned by the workforce module

retention_sms_campaigns.reason: Customer Retention round 2: win-back SMS campaigns created from the retention screen (modules/customers/src/retention)

retention_sms_recipients.reason: Customer Retention round 2: one row per customer in a retention SMS campaign; the worker sends each once

team_data_alert_runs.reason: Team Management round 2: runs of the team data-quality alert scan (team-data-alerts.repository)

team_data_alerts.reason: Team Management round 2: team data-quality alerts reviewed by managers

team_data_alert_events.reason: Team Management round 2: append-only history of each team data alert

team_data_nightly_runs.reason: Team Management round 2: the nightly team data job, one row per salon and night

team_onboarding_requests.reason: Team Management round 2 (migration 727): new-staff onboarding requests

team_staff_profiles.reason: Team Management round 2 (migration 727): extended staff profile data (birthday, onboarding) owned by workforce

team_staff_certifications.reason: Team Management round 2 (migration 727): staff licences / certifications and their verification

team_training_courses.reason: Team Management round 2 (migration 727): the salon's training courses

team_training_assignments.reason: Team Management round 2 (migration 727): training assigned to staff and its progress

team_training_events.reason: Team Management round 2 (migration 727): append-only history of training assignments

global_rewards_program.reason: Global Rewards Network (migration 733): the ONE central program row — redemption value, token value, pauses and platform limits — set by Super Admin only (LoyaltyRules.pdf §1.2)

global_earning_rule_versions.reason: Global Rewards Network (migration 733): Super Admin global default earning-rate versions, read live by every global-mode salon; no tenant_id by design (addendum §1.3)

global_rewards_accounts.reason: Global Rewards Network (migration 733): a verified customer identity's network points (customer_identities, keyed by the proven phone) — owned by the person across salons, never a salon row

global_points_ledger.reason: Global Rewards Network (migration 733): one identity's points history across participating salons; tenant_id records the salon whose sale / redemption caused the row, and a salon reads only its own rows (LoyaltyTokens.pdf §6.3 privacy)

global_rewards_enrollments.reason: Global Rewards Network (migration 733): a salon's participation (enrolled / suspended / withdrawn), managed by Super Admin

token_purchase_intents.reason: Global Rewards Network (migration 733): Buy Tokens — one logical prepaid purchase per idempotency key, spendable only at FUNDS_VERIFIED

token_purchase_events.reason: Global Rewards Network (migration 733): append-only status history of a token purchase

token_wallet_ledger.reason: Global Rewards Network (migration 733): append-only prepaid token wallet ledger of one salon

tenant_token_wallets.reason: Global Rewards Network (migration 733): ONE prepaid token wallet per salon — a projection of token_wallet_ledger (LoyaltyTokens.pdf §5.1)

tenant_earning_policy_versions.reason: Global Rewards Network (migration 733): a salon's GLOBAL / CUSTOM earning transitions, versioned and immutable once activated (LoyaltyRules.pdf §4)

reward_earn_transactions.reason: Global Rewards Network (migration 733): one earning judgement per paid ticket of the EARNING salon, with its full rule + funding snapshot; identity_id only links the customer's network account

reward_redemptions.reason: Global Rewards Network (migration 733): a checkout reward reservation / redemption at the REDEEMING salon

merchant_reimbursements.reason: Global Rewards Network (migration 733): what the network owes the redeeming salon (PAYABLE ≠ PAID); not a card payment

rewards_journal_entries.reason: Global Rewards Network (migration 733): balanced journal entry; tenant_id is the salon it concerns (NULL for platform cash lines)

rewards_journal_lines.reason: Global Rewards Network (migration 733): journal lines of a balanced entry (deferred balance trigger)

payout_attempts.reason: Global Rewards Network (migration 734): payout instructions for a salon payable; SETTLED only with verified provider settlement proof

reimbursement_adjustments.reason: Global Rewards Network (migration 734): append-only payable reductions / post-payout offset (recovery) claims

rewards_recon_runs.reason: Global Rewards Network (migration 734): platform books-check runs (daily + manual); no salon owns a run

rewards_recon_findings.reason: Global Rewards Network (migration 734): books-check findings; tenant_id names the salon a finding concerns (NULL platform-wide)

loyalty_fraud_alerts.reason: Global Rewards Network (migration 734): review-first fraud signals seen by Super Admin only (cross-salon platform data)

retention_health_runs.reason: Customer Retention & Win-Back guide (Oct 30 2026) §09: one row per read-only "Check Retention Data" run of a salon (overall status, per-check results with sample customer ids of that salon, ruleset / settings version, who ran it) — retention data-quality evidence next to retention_sms_campaigns

birthday_message_claims.reason: Birthday Campaigns guide (Oct 31 2026) §13–§14: the send-time claim behind "one birthday message per customer per occasion year per channel" (salon + customer + year + channel, the campaign that claimed it, claimed / sent / released) — next to customers.birthday

churn_watch_reviews.reason: Churn Watch guide (Nov 2 2026, migration 764): the AI Customer Profile assistant's internal churn review workflow — current review state per customer (reviewed / deferred); never a customer status
